This dataset contains five (5) scans of the Raymond Stampede Grounds, collected by the Capture2Preserv team on May 12th, 2023 for the Raymond Pioneer Museum and Historical Society. The data was collected with the GeoSLAM ZEB Horizon mobile scanner and all data was processed in GeoSLAM Connect v.2. These scans have not been registered together.
